look_here_first: Feel or closely inspect the broad leaves: this is the big sandpaper-textured Verbena, with broad ovate leaves and long, thin flowering spikes that can form a branched panicle.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: broad ovate leaves, much wider than those of the other native B013 species

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: upper leaf surface harshly scabrous/sandpapery from short stiff hairs

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: lower nodes can root adventitiously in wet or submerged conditions

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: long slender spikes, often grouped into a branched panicle

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flowers tiny relative to the very long spike

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stems and rachises scabrous with pustulate-based hairs

key_traits.label: Verbena training
key_traits.text: Separate these by leaf architecture + hair texture + spike/branching architecture before using flower color.
